title: Indigene
summary: IN'DIGENE, noun [Latin indigena; in or ind, and geno, gigno, to beget, or to be born.] One born in a country; a native animal or plant.

inlines.v: IN'DIGENE, noun [Latin indigena; in or ind, and geno, gigno, to beget, or to be born.] One born in a country; a native animal or plant.
